title: Every site.
Every call.
Every rupee.
scenes.vo: Four sites. Forty calls a day. A notebook for wages, WhatsApp for reports, and no idea where the money went.

scenes.tag: Run every site from your phone
scenes.vo: Meet the new Field O S. One calm app for every site you run.
And this is Mitra, your site buddy.

title: Every site.
One calm screen.
bullets: Attendance, expense, report, material: one tap
Today's brief tells you who needs you
scenes.vo: Home is calm and simple. Big buttons for attendance, expenses, the daily report and material. And today's brief tells you which site needs you.

title: Just say it.
It's saved.
scenes.ask: Add ₹5,000 spent on cement at Kompally
scenes.reply: Sure, Ravi. Here it is for Kompally Villa.
scenes.card: Expense ₹5,000 for Material at Kompally Villa, Block B · cement
scenes.final: Saved ₹5,000 for cement at Kompally Villa.
scenes.vo: Too busy to type? Just say it. Add five thousand for cement at Kompally. Field O S fills it in. You tap save.

title: Who came
today?
scenes.reply: 4 people punched in at Kompally Villa today: Ramesh, Suresh, Anil and Venkat. Lakshmi is absent.
scenes.vo: Ask it anything. Who came to Kompally today? It answers from your own records.

title: Your language.
Your team's too.
scenes.vo: Your whole team can use it in their own language. English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada or Marathi.

title: Telugu lo,
full app.
scenes.vo: Every screen, every button, in the language they pick. And Mitra reads replies aloud when you tap the speaker.

title: Wages,
added up.
scenes.vo: Saturday wages add themselves up from G P S attendance. Days, half days and overtime. No arguments.

title: Every rupee,
every site.
scenes.vo: Every rupee in and out, for every site, with the balance at the top.

title: Who you owe,
oldest first.
scenes.vo: See who you owe, oldest first, before a supplier stops your credit.

title: The owner's
evening brief.
scenes.vo: Every evening, the owner gets one brief. Which site has no report, which is over budget, and who needs a call.

title: Catch overspending
early.
scenes.vo: The dashboard compares every site with its budget, and warns you before it's too late.
It works on site even without internet, and syncs when you're back. Only the assistant needs a connection.

title: Mitra shows you
around in 2 minutes.
scenes.vo: New to it? Mitra's two-minute tour shows your team one full day on a sample site.
